records.title: CompliBench: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Compliance Violation Detection in Dialogue Systems
records.reason: CompliBench is an LLM-judge evaluation benchmark and automated data-generation pipeline. It does not propose runtime cost, latency, memory, or serving optimization.

records.title: Visual Preference Optimization with Rubric Rewards
records.reason: rDPO is an offline/on-policy preference training framework for visual reasoning. Its reported gains concern training and answer quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: OccuBench: Evaluating AI Agents on Real-World Professional Tasks via Language Environment Simulation
records.reason: OccuBench is a multi-domain agent benchmark using LLM-simulated environments. Its contribution is evaluation and simulation quality, not deployed inference savings.

records.title: Nexus: Same Pretraining Loss, Better Downstream Generalization via Common Minima
records.reason: Nexus is a pretraining optimizer that improves generalization at similar pretraining loss. The measured changes are training/generalization outcomes, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Vision-Language Navigation for Aerial Robots: Towards the Era of Large Language Models
records.reason: The primary paper is an aerial vision-language-navigation survey. It discusses onboard deployment and tradeoffs but contributes a taxonomy/research agenda rather than a concrete measured LLM/VLM inference optimization.
